item.title: First Steps with OXI One MKII / EP. 3: Groove
item.description: video upload by OXI Instruments First Steps with OXI One MKII "In Episode 3 we get into the groove! Groove is the subtle element that transforms a rigid pattern into something that feels alive. In this video, we explore how OXI ONE MKII handles groove, and why even the smallest timing and velocity variations can completely change the feel of a sequence."
